blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Wednesday reminded authorities to uphold their duties and refrain from violating the law following allegations that former House Speaker Martin Romualdez was allowed to leave jail with the help of a jail warden. Retired columnist Ramon Tulfo alleged that a jail warden had cut off the power supply, disabling CCTV cameras and allowing the presidential cousin to leave the New Quezon City Jail Male Dormitory. READ: BJMP: No power outage or Romualdez exit from QC jail The Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) earlier told the Inquirer that the claims were untrue, saying no power outage […]...
